policies.title: Expenses
rules: Meals during client travel are reimbursed up to USD 75 per day, receipts required.
Flights under 6 hours are booked in economy; flights of 6 hours or longer may be booked in premium economy.
Hotel nights are reimbursed up to USD 220 per night; a higher rate needs approval from the Chief Delivery Officer before booking.

Any single expense above USD 500 needs written pre-approval from the employee's manager. Meals are governed by the daily meal cap alone and never need pre-approval under this rule, so the two rules do not combine.
Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date; later claims are paid only if the Head of Finance and Operations approves them.

policies.title: Remote Work
rules: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week by default.
Days spent on site at a client do not count toward the 3-day remote limit.
Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 in the employee's office time zone, on remote days and office days alike.
Working from another country is allowed for up to 20 working days per calendar year, with manager approval requested at least 14 days ahead.
Days worked from abroad are still remote days, so the 3-day weekly limit and the 20-day annual limit both apply together.
A one-time home-office stipend of USD 600 is paid after the employee completes 90 days of service.

policies.title: Certification Bonus
rules: Passing a foundation-level exam (any Administrator, Associate or Specialist exam, including Tableau Desktop Specialist, or Platform App Builder) earns a bonus of USD 500.
Passing an advanced exam (any Consultant, Developer, Architect or Tableau Certified Data Analyst exam, including MuleSoft Developer and Architect exams) earns a bonus of USD 1,500.
Bonuses are paid in the next payroll run after the passing score is verified; if two exams are passed in the same payroll month, both bonuses are paid.
Exam fees are reimbursed through the annual learning budget in addition to the bonus, so the two combine.
Retaking an exam for a certification the employee already holds earns no bonus.
An employee who leaves within 12 months of receiving a bonus repays 50% of it, and certification bonuses are capped at USD 4,000 per calendar year per employee.

policies.title: On-Call
rules: On-call covers go-live hypercare and production incidents for clients on an active support agreement.
The weekly rotation runs from Monday 09:00 to the following Monday 09:00, and no employee is on call two weeks in a row.
The on-call allowance is USD 350 per week.
The on-call engineer must acknowledge a page within 15 minutes.
Incident work that lasts longer than 30 minutes earns USD 60 per incident in addition to the weekly allowance, so the two combine.
An overnight callout between 22:00 and 06:00 earns either the USD 60 incident payment or half a day off in lieu, chosen by the employee, never both.

runbooks.title: Full Sandbox Refresh and Post-Refresh Setup
prerequisites: Sandbox Admin access to the production org
Latest SandboxPrep Apex class merged to the main branch
Client approval for the refresh window
steps: Confirm the Full sandbox is eligible for refresh; a Full sandbox can be refreshed once every 29 days.
Export the sandbox custom settings, named credential list and email deliverability setting to the shared environment sheet.
Announce a 4-hour freeze window in the delivery channel and pause open deployments to the sandbox.
In Setup > Sandboxes choose Refresh, keep the existing name, select the Production edition template and attach the agreed sandbox template.
Wait for the completion email from Salesforce; refresh duration varies with data volume.
Run the SandboxPrep post-copy Apex class to mask contact emails, deactivate scheduled jobs and reset integration endpoints.
Set Email Deliverability to System email only and re-enter named credential secrets from the password vault.
Smoke-test login, one standard report and one integration callout, then lift the freeze.
rollback_steps: If SandboxPrep fails partway, fix the cause and re-run it; the class is safe to run repeatedly.
If masking is incomplete, set Email Deliverability to No access immediately and notify the client data owner.
If the refresh cannot be completed, deploy the last known metadata from the git main branch to a Developer Pro sandbox as a stand-in.
known_issues: A refresh requested inside the 29-day interval is blocked: the Refresh action is greyed out and the sandbox list shows the next available refresh date.
SandboxPrep fails with 'System.LimitException: Too many DML rows: 10001' when masking more than 10,000 contacts in one transaction; run it as Batch Apex with a scope of 200.

runbooks.title: Change Set Deployment to Production
prerequisites: Deployment connection authorized between the source sandbox and production
Release ticket with approved component list
Apex tests passing in the source sandbox
steps: Create an outbound change set in the source sandbox named with the release ID and date.
Add components and use View/Add Dependencies to include required custom fields, page layouts and Apex classes.
Upload the change set to production and wait for it to appear under Inbound Change Sets, which can take up to 30 minutes.
Run Validate on the inbound change set with the RunLocalTests test level.
Confirm code coverage is 75% or higher for the deployed classes and triggers.
Obtain written sign-off from the Chief Delivery Officer in the release ticket.
Run Deploy in the agreed release window.
Activate new flows and apply page layout assignments by hand, because change sets do not activate or assign them.
Watch Apex exception emails and Setup > Apex Jobs for 4 hours after deployment.
rollback_steps: Build a rollback change set from the pre-deployment metadata retrieved before release.
Deactivate any flows activated during the release.
Redeploy the previous versions of Apex classes and layouts from the tagged git commit.
Post an incident note in the release ticket with the time of rollback.
known_issues: Validation fails with 'Average test coverage across all Apex Classes and Triggers is 68%, 75% test coverage is required' when a new class has no tests.
A change set cannot contain more than 10,000 files; larger sets fail at upload and must be split into two change sets.

runbooks.title: Salesforce CLI Metadata Deployment
prerequisites: Salesforce CLI (sf) installed at the version pinned in the repository
Release user with Modify Metadata and Author Apex permissions
Release branch merged and tagged
steps: Authenticate with 'sf org login web --alias prod' using the release user.
Pull the release branch and confirm 'git status' shows a clean working tree.
Run 'sf project deploy start --dry-run --test-level RunLocalTests --target-org prod' to validate.
Note the validation job ID in the release ticket.
Review destructiveChanges.xml and confirm each listed component is approved for deletion.
Get approval from the delivery lead before deploying.
Run 'sf project deploy quick --job-id <id>' inside the 10-day window after validation.
Run 'sf project deploy report' and confirm the status is Succeeded.
Assign new permission sets with 'sf org assign permset' for the pilot users.
Run the smoke test Apex classes with 'sf apex run test' and check the pass result.
Monitor deployment-related errors in Event Log Files and Apex exception emails for 6 hours.
rollback_steps: Check out the previous release tag in git.
Run a validation deploy of the previous tag, then quick-deploy it.
Restore deleted components from the pre-release retrieve stored on the backup branch.
Reassign permission sets to the previous configuration.
known_issues: 'Error: No authorization information found for prod' appears when the stored login has expired; re-run the web login.
Quick deploy is rejected after 10 days with 'The validation is no longer valid'; run a fresh validation.
Large deployments can end with 'UNKNOWN_EXCEPTION: An unexpected error occurred. Please include this ErrorId'; retry once and then open a Salesforce Support case with the ErrorId.

runbooks.title: Legacy CRM Data Migration with Bulk API 2.0
prerequisites: Field mapping sheet signed off by the client data owner
External ID field Legacy_Id__c on each migrated object
Data Loader installed with Bulk API 2.0 enabled
steps: Confirm the mapping sheet version matches the extract files received from the client.
Assign the Bypass_Automation custom permission to the migration user so validation rules, duplicate rules and flows skip its changes.
Export a full backup of the target objects as CSV files before loading anything.
Load Accounts by upsert on Legacy_Id__c, splitting files so each stays under 100 MB.
Load Contacts by upsert, resolving the parent Account through the Legacy_Id__c external ID.
Load Opportunities and their line items in that order.
Load Tasks and Events, then notes and attachments.
Review the success and error CSV files and re-run the failed rows after correcting them.
Reconcile row counts per object against the source extract and confirm zero unexplained mismatches.
Remove the Bypass_Automation permission from the migration user and confirm automation fires on a test edit.
rollback_steps: Hard delete the loaded rows through Bulk API 2.0 using the ids in the success CSV files.
Restore any updated rows by upserting from the backup export.
Remove the bypass permission and confirm validation rules are active.
known_issues: Bulk API 2.0 rejects uploads larger than 150 MB with a request-size error; split the CSV.
'STRING_TOO_LONG: Account Name: data value too large' occurs when a legacy name exceeds 255 characters; truncate it in the mapping step.
'UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW' occurs when child rows for the same parent load in parallel; reload the failed rows in serial mode.

runbooks.title: Agentforce Service Agent Rollout
prerequisites: Agentforce and Einstein generative AI enabled in the target org
Knowledge articles indexed in a Data Library
Guardrail and escalation test plan approved by the client
Omni-Channel queue created for human escalation
steps: Confirm in Setup that Einstein generative AI and Agentforce are enabled in the target org.
Verify the agent user has the Agentforce Service Agent permission set and read access to Knowledge.
Deploy agent topics, actions and prompt templates from the sandbox using 'sf project deploy start'.
Run the guardrail test plan and confirm every adversarial prompt returns the approved safe fallback response.
Run batch tests in the Agentforce Testing Center and confirm topic classification accuracy meets the agreed threshold of 90%.
Configure the escalation action to route to the Omni-Channel queue with the conversation transcript attached.
Activate the agent version for the limited production group named in the pilot plan.
Verify Einstein Trust Layer data masking is applied to a test conversation containing sample card digits.
Send 10 scripted test conversations from a production test user and review the answers.
Monitor conversation logs and the escalation rate daily for 72 hours after activation.
Hold a pilot checkpoint with the client at the 72-hour mark and agree any topic changes.
Widen the limited group in stages only after the checkpoint is signed off.
rollback_steps: Deactivate the agent version in Agent Builder.
Switch the channel routing back to the human Omni-Channel queue.
Redeploy the previous agent metadata from the tagged commit.
Notify the client sponsor and support lead of the deactivation.
known_issues: 'Cannot modify an active agent version' appears when editing a live agent; deactivate it or create a new version.
Test runs report 'Failed to retrieve grounding data' until the Data Library has finished indexing newly added knowledge articles.
Activation is blocked when the agent user lacks the Agentforce Service Agent permission set.

runbooks.title: Permission Set and Permission Set Group Changes
prerequisites: Approved permission matrix
List of affected users and their licences
Sandbox with a recent copy of the production profiles
steps: Export the current assignments for the affected users with a SOQL query on PermissionSetAssignment.
Compare the proposed design to the permission matrix and confirm no new Modify All Data or View All Data grant is added.
Create or edit the permission sets in the sandbox and add them to the permission set group.
Wait for the group status to change from Updating to Updated before testing.
Deploy the permission set metadata to production and assign the group to the pilot users.
Use Login As with 3 representative users to confirm access to objects, fields and tabs.
Review Setup Audit Trail and support tickets for access-denied reports for 24 hours.
rollback_steps: Unassign the new group from the pilot users.
Reassign the previous permission sets from the exported assignment list.
Redeploy the previous permission set metadata from the tagged commit.
known_issues: A permission set group can show the status Outdated after a change; select Recalculate and wait for Updated.
Assignment fails with 'INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS_OR_READONLY' when the user's licence does not match the licence of a permission set in the group.
Deleting a permission set that belongs to a group fails with 'FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION'; remove it from the group first.

runbooks.title: Emergency Production Release Rollback
prerequisites: Pre-release git tag for the version being restored
Backup retrieve of production metadata taken before the release
Rollback decision authority named in the release plan
steps: Obtain the rollback decision from the Chief Delivery Officer and the client sponsor and note the decision time.
Freeze all other deployments to production.
Identify the pre-release git tag and check out that tag.
Retrieve the current production metadata to a backup branch for later analysis.
Run a validation deploy of the tagged metadata, then quick-deploy it.
Deactivate any flows or scheduled jobs added by the failed release.
Restore any data changed by the release from the backup CSV exports.
Notify stakeholders that production is restored and describe the user-facing effect.
Monitor error emails and Apex jobs for 4 hours and schedule a review within 3 business days.
rollback_steps: If the validation deploy fails, remove components in the order named in the error output using a destructive changes manifest.
If a flow cannot be deactivated, open it in Flow Builder and activate the previous version.
If the rollback cannot complete, open a Severity 1 case with Salesforce Support and keep the freeze in place.
known_issues: Redeploying the previous tag can fail with 'This component is referenced by other components' when new fields are still used by reports; delete the reports first.
Deleted custom fields stay in the recycle bin for 15 days; after that period their data cannot be restored.

runbooks.title: MuleSoft Application Deployment to CloudHub
prerequisites: Anypoint Platform access with Deploy permission for the target environment
Properties file with secure placeholders for each environment
Passing MUnit test suite
steps: Run the MUnit suite locally and confirm every test passes.
Build the Mule application package with Maven and check the artifact version number.
Confirm the target environment has enough vCores for the worker size in the deployment plan.
Upload the artifact to Anypoint Exchange for the release.
Set secure properties in Runtime Manager for the target environment.
Deploy the application to CloudHub with the agreed worker size and region.
Wait for the application status to show Started and open the logs to check for startup errors.
Run the Salesforce connectivity test flow and confirm a successful callout.
Enable alerts for failed message rate and worker CPU in Anypoint Monitoring.
Watch the dashboard for 48 hours and review error counts at 24 hours and at 48 hours.
rollback_steps: Redeploy the previous artifact version from Exchange.
Restore the previous secure property values.
Disable the new Salesforce callout flow with a feature flag property.
Inform the operations team using the runbook shipped with the integration.
known_issues: Deployment fails with 'Not enough vCores available' when the environment allocation is used up; stop an unused application or request more vCores.
'Could not resolve property placeholder sf.password' appears when a secure property is missing for the environment.
The application stays in Starting if the HTTP listener port is set to something other than 8081 in the CloudHub configuration.

runbooks.title: Experience Cloud Site Publish
prerequisites: Site changes approved in the sandbox
Accessibility review report signed off
Guest user profile access list approved
steps: Deploy the Experience Bundle and related metadata to production with the CLI.
Open Experience Builder in production and confirm the theme and navigation menus match the sandbox.
Confirm guest user profile access to the required Apex classes and objects.
Click Publish and wait for the confirmation email.
Test the site on desktop and mobile with a guest user and with a portal member.
Watch support requests and login history for 8 hours after publishing.
rollback_steps: Open Experience Builder and use the Publish history to restore the previous published version.
Revoke any new guest profile access added for this release.
known_issues: Publishing fails with 'Your site could not be published' when a page references a missing component; fix the page and retry.
Guests see 'Insufficient Privileges' for a new Apex class until it is added to the guest user profile.
Changes can take up to 24 hours to appear for users because of CDN caching, unless the cache is cleared in Settings.

runbooks.title: Marketing Cloud Journey Activation
prerequisites: Sender authentication package with SPF and DKIM configured
Approved email templates and audience definitions
Sendable data extension created in the target business unit
steps: Confirm the sendable data extension has SubscriberKey mapped to the contact key.
Review the journey canvas against the approved journey map.
Send test emails to the seed list and check rendering in three email clients.
Run the deliverability checklist, including a spam filter score check.
Validate the journey with the Validate button and clear all errors.
Activate the journey during the agreed send window.
Review entry counts and send logs after the initial run.
Monitor bounce rate, unsubscribes and journey errors for 24 hours.
rollback_steps: Pause the journey and stop new entries.
Re-run the audience filter to remove contacts who entered incorrectly.
Revert any changed automation or send classification.
known_issues: Journey validation fails with 'Entry source data extension must contain a SubscriberKey field' when the key is not mapped.
A send is held with 'Send Classification not found' if the send classification was not copied to the target business unit.

runbooks.title: Revenue Cloud Pricing and Quote Approval Release
prerequisites: Product catalog export approved by finance
Pricing rule test cases with expected prices
Approval matrix signed off by the Head of Finance and Operations of the client
steps: Freeze price book and product changes in production for the release window.
Back up the current price books, price rules and approval processes.
Deploy the pricing rule and approval metadata to production.
Load the product catalog and price book entries with Bulk API 2.0.
Activate the pricing rules in the agreed order.
Run the pricing test cases and compare calculated prices to the expected values.
Check that discounts above the threshold route to the correct approver.
Confirm contract and renewal templates generate correctly from a test quote.
Send a test billing handoff file and confirm the finance system accepts it.
Walk the finance team through the changes in a short training session.
Lift the freeze and announce the release to sales users.
Monitor quote calculation errors and approval queue delays for 12 hours.
rollback_steps: Deactivate the new pricing rules.
Restore the previous price book entries from the backup export.
Redeploy the previous approval process metadata.
Notify the finance team that quoting returned to the previous configuration.
known_issues: Quote calculation can fail with 'Apex CPU time limit exceeded' when more than 300 line items are priced in one calculation; reduce rule complexity or split the quote.
'DUPLICATE_VALUE: duplicate value found: PricebookEntry' appears if a product is loaded twice into the same price book.

runbooks.title: Data Cloud Data Stream and Identity Resolution Release
prerequisites: Source connections authorized in the target Data Cloud org
Approved data model mappings
Identity resolution match rules agreed with the client
steps: Create the data streams for each approved source and confirm connectivity.
Map the source fields to the unified data model and save the mappings.
Run an initial ingestion and compare row counts to the source.
Create the identity resolution ruleset with the approved match rules and reconciliation settings.
Run the ruleset and wait for the job to complete, which can take several hours for large data volumes.
Review unified profile counts and sample 25 matched profiles by hand.
Publish the initial segments and verify the segment population.
Activate the segments to the agreed target only after the review is signed off.
Monitor ingestion refresh status and segment population for 36 hours.
rollback_steps: Pause the activation targets.
Delete the new ruleset or disable its match rules.
Pause the data streams added for this release.
known_issues: Ingestion can fail with 'Data type mismatch for field' when a source field type differs from the mapped data model field type.
A ruleset cannot be edited while a run is in progress; wait for it to finish or cancel the run.
Segments publish with zero members when the ruleset has not completed.

runbooks.title: Tableau Dashboard and Data Source Publishing
prerequisites: Publisher role on the target Tableau project
Data source credentials stored as embedded credentials
steps: Publish the certified data source to the production project with an extract refresh schedule.
Check that the data source certification label and description are visible.
Publish each executive dashboard using the certified data source.
Test the dashboards with row-level security filters for two sample users.
Send the access link to the executive group.
rollback_steps: Revert the dashboards to the previous version in Revision History.
Remove the new data source from the project and reconnect dashboards to the previous one.
known_issues: A scheduled extract refresh fails when it reaches the 2-hour job time limit; trim columns or add incremental refresh.
Publishing is blocked with 'Cannot publish: the embedded credentials are invalid' when the Salesforce connection token has expired.

runbooks.title: Service Cloud Omni-Channel Routing and Entitlement Release
prerequisites: Routing configurations approved by the support lead
Entitlement process definitions reviewed
Agent skills and queue membership list
steps: Deploy the queue, routing configuration and service channel metadata to production.
Add agents to the queues and set their presence status values.
Activate the entitlement process and milestones for the support case types.
Create 5 test cases and confirm they route to the correct queue.
Check that milestones start and fire on the correct timers.
Brief the support team on the new routing before the release window ends.
Monitor queue backlog and milestone violations for 16 hours.
rollback_steps: Switch the routing configuration back to the previous version.
Deactivate the new entitlement process.
Move waiting cases manually to the previous queue.
known_issues: Cases do not route when the agent is not set to an available presence status.
'Entitlement process cannot be activated: a milestone has no time trigger' occurs if the process is incomplete.
